Renovation Cost in Dubai 2026

Renovating a home in Dubai in 2026 costs between AED 500 and AED 1,500 per square foot, depending on the finish level and scope of work involved.

How much does a villa renovation cost?

A full villa renovation ranges from AED 400,000 to AED 1.2M according to platform project data.
